name: idea.solid
description: Audience Desk: verify one assembled post-idea card before it reaches a human queue. Judges whether the angle is original rather than a restatement, whether the hook-to-payoff promise holds, and how generic it reads. Advisory until calibrated.

archetype.instructions: Given the title, topic, hooks, and the evidence quotes it was built from, which archetype is this post idea?

criteria.original_take: Names a specific mechanism, tension, or number the obvious version of this post would miss
criteria.competent: Solid and useful, but the angle is the expected one for this topic
criteria.repeat: Restates the generic advice already saturating this topic
criteria.rehash: Vague -- the title does not say what the reader leaves with

promise_holds.instructions: The hooks, the topic, and the evidence quotes form one continuous promise: a reader pulled in by the hook would find the evidence delivers on it

generic_risk.instructions: This idea reads like generic AI-written content marketing that any competitor could publish unchanged

rules.reason: title does not name a payoff -- rewrite before queueing (threshold provisional, pending calibration)
saturated generic take -- the deterministic heat score found a topic, not an angle
reads as generic marketing -- needs a human or frontier pass for a real angle
hook and evidence do not line up -- the card needs regrouping

notes.archetype: created 2026-09-20 for audience-desk idea cards; deterministic ranking stays in ideas.mjs, this only judges quality.
